neighbours.label: a description of an extraordinary ability (photographic memory, could tell X just by Y), where 'effortlessly' or 'ability' fits next
fire: As a child, Tesla reportedly had an eidetic memory for whole books.
The young pianist could play any tune perfectly after hearing it once.
Legend says the old tracker could tell a horse's age just by its hoofprint.
He was gifted with perfect pitch and could name any note instantly.
The chess prodigy could play ten opponents blindfolded at once.
With her remarkable memory she could recite every line of the play.
The sommelier could identify a wine's vintage simply by its smell.
Mozart was able to compose entire symphonies in his head.
quiet: As a child, Tesla reportedly lived in a small village with his family.
The young pianist practiced scales for an hour after school.
The old tracker lived alone in a cabin near the river.
He took music lessons twice a week at the community center.
The chess club meets every Thursday in the library basement.
With her new job she could finally afford a car.
The sommelier poured the wine and set the bottle on the table.
Mozart was born in Salzburg in 1756.
